jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic, Customer Engagement
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 1 year of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience building aentic technologies.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or a business related field.
* 2 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* Experience working on products in the Enterprise Business Intelligence (BI), data analytics, or internal tooling space.
* Familiarity or foundational experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-motivated chat or automated tools.
* Proven capability to execute and launch features successfully in a highly cross-functional environment (e.g., working with Sellers, Analysts, and Operations teams).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.  
  
Customer Engagement (CE) is a team within Ads focused on providing tools and products to enable Google to intelligently engage customers and help them succeed at scale. Our solutions cover marketing, business, and support for the Ads business and also customer support for Google’s consumer ecosystem with many of those products serving more than 1B monthly users like YouTube, Play, Hardware, Photos, Maps, Search, and Gmail to name a few. The team drives the design and development of agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that transform how support practitioners engage with customers through automated, intelligent conversations. Our tools manage contextualized diagnosis, multi-step troubleshooting, resolution, and communication with human agents in the loop.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and advocate the product goal, strategy, and roadmap for features and quality of the Cases AI Agentic system.
* Prioritize the product backlog, make trade-off decisions, and manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch and iteration. Translate user needs and business requirements into detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories, and specifications.
* Collaborate deeply with Engineering, User Experience (UX) Designers, UX Researchers, and Technical Program Managers to ideate, design, and deliver innovative solutions.
* Engage with key stakeholders and users including Sellers, Analysts, and Global Business Organization (GBO) partners to understand their needs, pain points, and opportunities.
* Communicate product plans, progress, and results to stakeholders, leadership, and cross-functional partners across CE and its ecosystem.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

As a Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and operate multi-agent workflows that bring automation and intelligence to accelerate asset management.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Design and build intelligent agent workflows that coordinate specialized AI agents through controlled orchestration frameworks.
* Engineer end-to-end multi-agent pipelines — from data retrieval and reasoning to evaluation and decision-making.
* Integrate frontier AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude), or fine-tuned internal models for reasoning, enrichment, and contextual decision-making — select and switch models based on complexity, cost, and accuracy trade-offs.
* Design, develop and maintain existing features, and enhance platform capabilities based on user feedback.Develop robust back-end services and APIs (Python or ServiceNow).
* Collaborate closely with SAM/HAM domain experts,product managers, and engineers to translate automation goals into resilient agentic systems.
* Build intuitive UIs and dashboards in Service Portal, React, or Angular
* Leverage retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) strategies to ground AI reasoning in factual context from data sources — ensuring decisions are traceable and verifiable.
* Apply observability, logging, and traceability across all agent workflows to ensure reproducibility, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Participate in code reviews, post-deployment analysis, and production debugging to maintain system quality and stability at scale.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 6-8 years of software development experience with strong command on a any object oriented language Java/Python.
* Hands-on experience developing LLM-powered or agent-based systems using frameworks for production use cases.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, event-driven systems, asynchronous workflows, and scalable back-end design.
* Experience implementing frontier AI models in enterprise workflow applications.
* Strong problem solving & foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and design patterns, with attention to performance and scalability.
* Experience deploying AI or automation systems in production, emphasizing versioning, traceability, and performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, and prompt optimization.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform or willingness to learn it.
* Strong focus on code quality, observability, logging, and traceability — these are non-negotiable.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage or critically evaluate AI integration in work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving — including using AI-powered coding tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, and exploring AI's impact on business functions.

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. jobs.description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech! 
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of Full stack Developer!
  
  
We are seeking a talented Full Stack Developer with strong hands-on experience in both frontend and backend web development. The ideal candidate will have expertise in modern technologies such as React.js/Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, GCP, GenAI or similar frameworks, and a proven track record of building scalable, high-performance web applications.
  
  
In this role, You will..
  
  
**Be responsible for the following:**  

* Full-Stack Development: Design/Build a scalable, high-performance, and secure end to-end web application features across the full stack.
* Solution Architecture: Translate product and business requirements into well architected technical solutions.
* Frontend Engineering: Develop and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using modern frameworks.

* Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain clear technical documentation covering system design, APIs, and key implementations.
* Continuous Innovation: Stay up to date with emerging web technologies and modern tooling (including AI-assisted workflows) to continuously improve product and developer experience.

What are we looking for?
  

* Full Stack: Strong hands-on experience in both frontend and backend web development using modern frameworks (e.g. React/Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI or similar)
* Web Architecture: Solid understanding of web application architecture, including client server communication, RESTful APIs design patterns
* Frontend Engineering: Proven experience building responsive, scalable and performant user interface using HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript
* Database Management: Hands-on experience with database including data modelling and query optimization
* API Integration: Experience designing, building and consuming APIs and integrating with third party services (e.g. GCP services)
* Version Control & Quality: Strong knowledge of Git workflows, code review and maintaining high code quality standards
* DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and development workflows
* Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP) and modern deployment workflows
* AI-Assisted Development: Comfortable with using AI tools to troubleshoot stack errors , test and build APIs
* Prototyping & Innovation: Expert at design thinking and understanding the business of use case, followed by prototyping using AI tools
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with designers, product managers and other engineers
* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills

What’s In It for You?
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

* Online Coding Test

jobs.title: Senior Product Associate - Legal Regulatory Compliance
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Want to make a difference in Legal and regulatory Control Product? This is where you can!

As a Senior Product Associate in the Legal & Regulatory Compliance & Control Product team you will deliver product capabilities that depend on reliable, well-defined data. You will work within an agreed product roadmap and priorities, this role translates user and business needs into clear product requirements and engineering-ready data specifications. You will also works closely with Product Managers, Operations, Engineering, Data Owners, and data platform teams to clarify definitions, investigate data availability, resolve delivery questions, and validate that the resulting capability meets its intended use.

You are expected to own the quality and completion of assigned requirements and data-enablement work, while escalating decisions about product direction, priority, material scope, and cross-product trade-offs to the Product Manager.

Job responsibilities

* Participate in product discovery with users and operational stakeholders; document the workflow problem, user need, current-state friction, and intended product outcome for assigned features.
* Translate agreed priorities into user stories, functional requirements, data requirements, edge cases, and testable acceptance criteria.
* Use approved AI-assisted curation to draft stories, data specifications, and test cases; apply human judgment to validate each output.
* Define required data elements and business meanings for assigned capabilities, documenting assumptions, valid values, derivation rules, and questions requiring a Data Owner's decision.
* Create and maintain source-to-target mapping artifacts for assigned features, including business definitions, source fields, transformation logic, relevant APIs or events, and target fields, in partnership with Engineering and data specialists.
* Use SQL-based profiling and reconciliation to investigate data availability, completeness, and consistency; document findings and recommend appropriate data-quality checks.
* Work with Engineering and QA to develop test scenarios for calculated fields, data movement, and product behavior, and help validate that delivered functionality meets acceptance criteria.
* Track feature-level data dependencies and decisions with Data Owners, Application Owners, and impacted product teams; escalate blockers and material changes in scope or timing.
* Support backlog refinement, delivery planning, demonstrations, release readiness, and post-release review for assigned work.
* Gather user feedback and product measures to identify defects, usability issues, or opportunities for improvement.
* Create or adapt approved AI tools to close delivery gaps, streamline repeatable work, and reduce rework on assigned features.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Experience in product delivery, business analysis, data product, or integration work that includes requirements and data specifications.
* Ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, field definitions, mappings, and test scenarios.
* Strong SQL proficiency for profiling and reconciliation, with working knowledge of data modeling concepts such as entities, keys, grain, and effective dating.
* Familiarity with API payloads or event schemas and experience working with engineers to implement data-dependent requirements.
* Strong communication and organization skills, including the ability to make unresolved questions and dependencies visible.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to curate product and data artifacts, validate outputs, and improve delivery workflows.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Operations teams develop and manage innovative, secure service solutions to meet clients' needs globally. Developing and using the latest technology, teams work to deliver industry-leading capabilities to our clients and customers, making it easy and convenient to do business with the firm. Teams also drive growth by refining technology-driven customer and client experiences that put users first, providing an unparalleled experience.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer Digital & AI
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**ABOUT IQ-EQ**

We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.

Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.

We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

 **Job Description**

**Introduction**

We are seeking a passionate Software Engineer with strong backend development, microservices, DevOps, and Cloud Engineering expertise. This role focuses on building, automating, deploying, and operating scalable cloud‑native applications and infrastructure while ensuring reliability, security, and efficiency.

**What You'll Do**

* You'll design, implement, and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines and automated release strategies, including Blue-Green, Canary, and Rolling Deployments, to accelerate and improve software delivery.
* You'll architect, deploy, and manage highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS, including backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure automation solutions.
* You'll build, deploy, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, ensuring reliable platform operations, networking performance, and workload stability in production environments.
* You'll develop automation tools, APIs, operational utilities, and deployment scripts using Python, integrating cloud services, CI/CD platforms, observability solutions, and infrastructure management workflows.
* You'll implement and manage monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and security controls using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, and CloudWatch, while supporting incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvements in reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.

**What we offer**

* Competitive Compensation: Annual package including base salary, allowances, and performance incentives.
* Health & Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and accident coverage.
* Allowances & Support: Transportation allowance, internet allowance, and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy supporting work–life balance.
* Career Growth: Exposure to cutting‑edge AI/ML technologies and opportunities to work across Generative AI, MLOps, and cloud‑native solutions.

  
**Qualifications**

**About You**

* You hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and have 3-7 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, or similar technical roles.
* You possess strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, automation, and Python, along with a solid understanding of Linux, networking, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
* You have experience designing and supporting scalable, highly available production systems, infrastructure automation frameworks, Kubernetes-based applications, developer productivity platforms, and monitoring and observability solutions.
* You are familiar with modern engineering practices such as SRE, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering, distributed systems, API gateways, event-driven architectures, and security-integrated deployment pipelines.
* You bring experience with technologies such as FastAPI, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, AI/ML platforms, or MLOps, and thrive in product-driven environments where collaboration, innovation, reliability, and continuous improvement are key to success.

  
**Additional Information**

**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Position: Performance Marketing Specialist.

Company: Adpulse Digital PVT LTD

CTC: 4 to 6 lacs

Exp: 2 to 5 yrs

Work Location: Madhapur, Hyderabad

Employment type: In person

We are looking for a data-driven and results-oriented **Performance Marketing Specialist** to plan, execute, optimize, and scale digital advertising campaigns across multiple channels.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with paid search, paid social, campaign analytics, conversion optimization, and performance reporting. You will be responsible for driving qualified traffic, leads, conversions, and revenue while continuously improving campaign ROI.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and execute performance marketing campaigns across **Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads**, and other relevant platforms.
* Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, and ad placements.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, audience research, and market analysis.
* Create and optimize campaigns across the full marketing funnel, including awareness, consideration, lead generation, and conversion.
* Develop and test ad creatives, copy, landing pages, audiences, and offers.
* Monitor key performance metrics such as **CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, and customer acquisition cost**.
* Continuously optimize campaigns to improve acquisition efficiency and profitability.
* Set up and monitor conversion tracking, pixels, events, UTM parameters, and attribution.
* Analyze campaign and website performance using tools such as **Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio**, and advertising platform dashboards.
* Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Work closely with content, creative, sales, product, and web teams to improve campaign performance.
* Identify new growth opportunities, channels, audiences, and testing strategies.
* Conduct A/B tests and use data to make informed marketing decisions.
* Stay updated on changes in advertising platforms, tracking technologies, privacy regulations, and digital marketing trends.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in performance/digital marketing.
* Strong experience with **Google Ads and Meta Ads**.
* Working knowledge of **Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager**.
* Understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, remarketing, and funnel optimization.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Good understanding of landing-page optimization and conversion rate optimization.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Google Ads or Meta certifications.
* Experience with LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, or other paid media platforms.
* Experience with lead-generation or e-commerce campaigns.
* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
* Experience managing significant advertising budgets.
* Basic understanding of SEO, content marketing, and email marketing.
* Experience with attribution and marketing analytics tools.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Qualified leads / conversions generated
* Cost per lead (CPL) / cost per acquisition (CPA)
* Return on ad spend (ROAS)
* Conversion rate
* Customer acquisition cost (CAC)
* Revenue generated from paid channels

**Overview**

The Defender for Office 365 product group owns the protection experience for email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. The product management team drives end-to-end ownership across the product lifecycle, partnering with groups and stakeholders across the organization and directly with customers and partners. As part of Microsoft XDR, the product spans real-time detection, post-delivery response and recovery, investigation and hunting, and pre-breach capabilities. The team owns one of the largest security solutions in the XDR portfolio and helps shape how communication and productivity security will work in an era of AI-powered social engineering, using AI to strengthen detection and making MDO the trusted entry point into the broader Defender suite. The group works at the intersection of protection efficacy, explainability and everyday usability, serving SOC analysts, email administrators and end users alike.

 **Responsibilities**

Are you a product leader who wants to own a product line that protects organizations every single day, and to build the team that delivers it Come work with us at the largest security company in the world, on one of its most broadly deployed security products.

Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protects email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. Attackers are shifting from recognizable malicious artifacts toward adaptive, multi-step social engineering, and generative AI is lowering the cost of personalizing those attacks at scale. Staying ahead of that shift — while keeping protection fast, explainable and operable at enterprise scale, is the challenge this role leads.

You will oversee a portfolio of complex engagements while developing high-performing teams and shaping a sustainable security product. You will own the overall health, quality and success of a product line and its features within the MDO portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior PMT
jobs.description:
**Description**
Our mission is to ensure customers trust Amazon to deliver a perfect order experience on every order. The Order Performance team within Perfect Order Experience (POE) is responsible for setting performance standards and ensuring that every purchase in our stores meets or exceeds Amazon's high bar for fulfillment quality and customer service quality — regardless of seller or channel. For our external selling partners, we set minimum performance expectations and enforce those expectations by limiting selling privileges if needed, while incentivizing sellers to improve performance and address customer pain points.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager-Tech for Enforcement Decisioning, you will own the logic that determines when enforcement triggers — the threshold framework that translates seller performance metrics into enforcement decisions across all Order Performance policies and all global marketplaces. You will build intelligent, data-driven decisioning that calibrates enforcement to the tradeoff between customer harm prevented and seller value lost. You will also own the criteria for exemptions, leniency, and permanent enforcement, determining which sellers deserve differentiated treatment. You will partner with data scientists, software engineers, policy teams, and operations stakeholders to define the vision, design experiments, and ship decisioning systems that reduce order defects for hundreds of millions of customers while preserving the seller value that drives Amazon's flywheel.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for enforcement decisioning, including data-driven threshold models, exemption frameworks, permanent enforcement pathways, and graduated enforcement calibration across multiple fulfillment quality policies
* Make trade-off decisions across enforcement model design (segmentation, economic tradeoff curves, marketplace-specific vs. global calibration)
* Design and launch enforcement decisioning systems that maximize defect prevention while minimizing unnecessary enforcement of valuable selection
* Design exemption and leniency logic — including thresholds for high-value listings, enforcement leniency for sellers with sustained clean performance, and graduated protection mechanisms
* Run A/B and holdout experiments to measure the causal impact of threshold changes on customer experience and business metrics— translating experimental results into production rollout decisions
* Author the long-term enforcement strategy and present to senior leadership, contributing to annual planning cycles and writing strategy documents that align cross-functional stakeholders

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
  
  
The Product Owner partners closely with
**Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams**
to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
**clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact**
in a complex, enterprise data environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership & Accountability**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment**

* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.

**Backlog, Roadmap & Delivery Management**

* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

**Governance, Quality & Standards**

* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:

+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.

**Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Product Owner is a
**critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model**
, ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

jobs.title: AVP_ Data Products-Wealth Management and AI Data Products
jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Job Overview**
LPL Financial is seeking an AVP, Data Product Owner (DPO) to lead Wealth Management (WM) data products while driving large-scale adoption of AI-powered workflow automation across the enterprise data ecosystem.
  
  
This role combines strategic Data Product Leadership with hands-on oversight of AI agent frameworks and automation platforms. The AVP will define the roadmap for AI-enabled data products, guide teams in building scalable agent-based systems, and ensure production-ready deployment aligned with governance, security, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI Strategy and Innovation**

* Define and lead the strategy for AI-driven workflow automation across the data ecosystem.
* Oversee the design and implementation of AI agents and reusable automation frameworks.
* Establish best practices for agent orchestration, tool integration (APIs, SQL, metadata platforms), and system design.
* Define evaluation, monitoring, and reliability standards for AI systems (guardrails, observability, performance tracking).
* Drive reuse and scalability of AI capabilities across multiple data domains.

**Technical & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Business teams to deliver AI-enabled solutions.
* Translate strategic business needs into scalable AI and data product architectures.
* Provide oversight on data models, pipelines, lineage, and integrations.
* Influence platform decisions related to AI, data catalog, and governance tools.

**What are we looking for?**
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
**pursue greatness**
,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 7–10+ years of experience in Data Products, Product Management, Applied AI, or platform-oriented roles.
* Strong expertise in SQL and data platforms (distributed systems, data lakes, integration layers).
* Strong Python proficiency with experience in AI/ML workflows and automation systems.
* Experience designing and scaling AI agents or workflow automation systems in enterprise environments.
* Experience defining AI architecture patterns involving tool-using agents (APIs, SQL, enterprise systems).
* Experience working with LLM platforms (Amazon Bedrock preferred or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of production-grade AI systems, including monitoring, observability, and reliability patterns.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex data and AI initiatives.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong leadership and strategic thinking.
* Deep understanding of data governance, quality, and lineage.
* Ability to translate AI innovations into scalable enterprise solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management across executive and technical audiences.
* Experience operating in regulated environments (financial services preferred).
* Focus on scalability, reliability, and trust in AI-enabled systems.

**Preferences**

* Experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain Agents, or similar).
* Familiarity with context management techniques such as embeddings, vector databases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience with event-driven or microservices-based architectures.
* Exposure to model evaluation techniques and AI performance benchmarking.

Our mission is to simplify decisionmaking across hospitals, clinics, and care teams by bringing clarity, precision, and actionability to every layer of healthcare operations.

Our products power large health systems, influence missioncritical workflows, and support clinical and nonclinical teams in delivering safer, faster, and more coordinated care.

For more details, please refer to our website at https://www.medha-analytics.ai/

**Shape the Next-Generation Intelligence Products:**  
Medha is building a unified intelligence ecosystem for healthcare. As a designer, you’ll influence products that drive decisions for clinicians, operations, business leaders, and frontline users.

**Be an Early Builder:**  
Our design team is new and growing. You’ll play a foundational role in establishing the design culture, processes, and standards from the ground up.

**Solve Real, High-Impact Problems:**  
Every product you design directly supports patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and healthcare quality across some of the largest health systems.

You’ll have opportunities to meet users across hospitals, understand real-world behaviours, and translate them into actionable product experiences.

***Experience:***

* A minimum of 3 years of experience in the analytics tech stack, ETL/Data Transformation and Data Visualization, Data Science tools
* Hands-on Experience with modelling, data science, data visualization and data governance.

***Preferred Qualifications:***

* Comfortable working with Big Data technologies building and designing products that utilize both real time as well as batch data streams at scale.
* Ability to write and validate SQL queries and to ensure data is validated.
* Ability to understand ETL structures and concepts.
* Ability to understand data visualization structures and concepts.
* Demonstrated data driven decision-making capabilities. Strong analytical skills to influence product decisions.
* Experience taking direction and input from multiple sources and creating a shared product vision.
* Demonstrated ability to work on a diverse scope of projects requiring detailed analysis, creative/practical problem solving, and sound judgement.

* Project management of analytics / data intelligence projects.
* Strong communication skills.

jobs.description:
**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

  

**1.** **Internal platform product roadmap**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for CIMET's internal platform layer: the tools, consoles, dashboards, and workflow systems used by Operations, Finance, Partner Management, CX, and the Product team itself.
* Before defining what to build, map how the system works end-to-end: where data originates, how it moves between teams and tools, where it breaks or gets duplicated, and what the downstream consequences of each failure point are.
* Define what gets built, upgraded, automated, or eliminated. Prioritise based on system-level impact: not just time saved in one team, but friction and error removed from the broader operating chain.
* Maintain a live inventory of current internal tools and workflows with an honest assessment of what is working, what is broken, what is redundant, and what creates hidden dependencies that any change must account for.
* Set quarterly targets for workflow automation coverage and manual effort reduction, and report against them.

  

**2.** **System redesign before automation**

* Treat automation as the second step, not the first. Before any workflow is automated, establish whether the workflow is worth automating: is it structured correctly, does it have the right inputs, does it produce the right outputs, or does it need to be redesigned first?
* Map process interdependencies across teams before making changes. Understand what each workflow receives from upstream and delivers downstream, so that a change in one area does not create invisible breakage elsewhere.
* Identify where manual workarounds have become load-bearing: processes that exist only because a system gap was never fixed, that now have teams depending on them. These need redesign, not automation.
* Define data standards and workflow contracts at the system level: what information flows between teams, in what format, at what frequency, with what quality guarantees. Automation built without these contracts creates fragile pipelines.
* Own the transition from current state to redesigned state: sequencing changes so that teams are not left without working processes during the shift, and so that new automations land on a clean foundation.

  

**3.** **Automation and AI implementation**

* Identify and implement rules-based automation across high-frequency, high-friction internal workflows using n8n. Own the automation backlog end-to-end: scoping, requirement definition, implementation coordination, testing, and rollout.
* Identify where GenAI integration materially improves an internal workflow: document processing, lead quality assessment, report generation, exception triaging, or communication drafting. Specify the product requirements, not just the use case.
* Manage CIMET's internal agentic AI programme: multi-step workflows where AI agents take autonomous actions across systems. Define what agents should own, what their boundaries are, what the human-in-the-loop checkpoints are, and how failures are caught.
* Maintain rigorous output quality standards for every AI-assisted workflow: accuracy benchmarks, fallback handling, escalation paths, and monitoring dashboards. No AI workflow ships without a defined quality floor and observable telemetry.

  

**4.** **Internal tooling upgrades**

* Own the upgrade agenda for existing internal tools: partner management consoles, operations dashboards, agent tooling, finance and reconciliation systems, and reporting infrastructure.
* Evaluate each tool upgrade in its system context: what does this tool receive from other systems, what does it feed into, and does the upgrade create or remove integration points that affect the broader platform?
* Define clear upgrade briefs: what the current tool does poorly, what the new experience should deliver, what success looks like in measurable terms.
* Partner with engineering to ensure internal tool upgrades are built to platform standards: no bespoke one-off builds that create maintenance debt or system fragmentation.
* Own UAT for internal product launches: coordinate with operational teams, define acceptance criteria, and do not sign off on releases that do not meet the bar.

  

**5.** **Cross-functional stakeholder management**

* Serve as the primary product contact for internal business functions on their tooling and automation needs. Understand their workflows deeply enough to form an independent point of view on what they actually need versus what they think they want.
* Run structured discovery with operational teams: map workflows, identify friction points, surface cross-team dependencies that stakeholders cannot see from inside their own function, and prioritise by ROI at the system level.
* Manage competing stakeholder priorities without letting every team get whatever they ask for. Maintain a transparent prioritisation framework that internal teams can see and challenge.
* Communicate roadmap, delivery status, and outcomes to senior stakeholders with enough clarity that decisions can be made without needing to dig into detail.

  

**6.** **Automation ROI tracking**

* Define and track the business case for every automation initiative: hours saved per week, error rate before and after, cycle time reduction, and cost impact where quantifiable.
* Produce a quarterly Internal Platform ROI summary covering what shipped, what it delivered, and what the pipeline looks like for the next quarter.
* Build the internal case for continued investment in platform automation by making the outcomes visible to leadership.

  
  

**Experience required**

* 4 to 5 years of product management experience with a strong weighting toward platform products, internal tools, or workflow automation.

### Job Summary

TriNet is seeking a Product Manager to own and drive the payroll product area within its HR services platform. This role sits at the intersection of payroll domain expertise and modern product craft - translating complex compliance, tax, and pay-processing requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable product experiences for employers and their employees.

The ideal candidate combines deep payroll domain knowledge with strong product thinking and the ability to work across engineering, design, operations, and compliance teams to deliver outcomes end-to-end across the product development lifecycle.

### Key Responsibilities

* Own the product roadmap for the payroll domain - from discovery through delivery and adoption - aligning with business strategy and customer needs.
* Translate payroll, tax, and compliance requirements into clear, prioritized product requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
* Partner with engineering and design as a single-threaded owner to scope, sequence, and ship features with quality and on time.
* Drive payroll accuracy, run-cycle reliability, and exception/error handling as first-class product concerns.
* Use data and product analytics (especially Pendo) to measure adoption, identify friction, and inform prioritization.
* Manage the run-the-business (RTB) backlog alongside roadmap initiatives, balancing defect resolution with strategic investment.
* Engage stakeholders across operations, customer success, compliance, and leadership; communicate trade-offs in clear, decision-ready language.
* Stay current on payroll regulations, multi-jurisdiction tax handling, and competitive/industry trends to inform product direction.

### Required Qualifications

* 7-10 years of total experience with 4+ years in product management, ideally for B2B SaaS or HR/fintech platforms.
* Demonstrable payroll domain depth - pay calculation, tax withholding, deductions, garnishments, off-cycle/on-cycle runs, and compliance.
* Experience building or managing products in HCM, HRIS, payroll, benefits, or PEO/ASO environments.
* Strong product thinking: problem framing, prioritization, and the ability to balance customer, business, and technical constraints.
* Proven ability to write crisp PRDs/user stories and partner effectively with engineering and design.
* Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfort with product analytics and data-informed decision-making.
* Bachelors degree; equivalent practical experience considered.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with US payroll and multi-state tax compliance, or comparable regulated payroll markets.
* Exposure to PEO (Professional Employer Organization) or ASO (Administrative Services Organization) models.
* Familiarity with payroll integrations - GL, time attendance, benefits, and tax-filing partners.
* Experience with analytics tools such as Pendo, and discovery practices for B2B products.
* Prior work on platforms serving small and mid-sized businesses (SMB) at scale.

### Core Competencies

* Domain credibility - can hold their own with payroll operations and compliance experts.
* Ownership - drives outcomes end-to-end rather than executing tickets in isolation.
* Clarity - frames decisions, trade-offs, and edge cases in PM-ready, stakeholder-friendly language.
* Customer obsession - anchors prioritization in real user problems and measurable impact.

### Work Environment

* Work in a clean, pleasant, and comfortable office work setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* This position is 100% in office.

Owns the day-to-day flow of delivery for a ServiceNow product squad —

* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Working knowledge of Kanban
* Experience managing and maintaining product/sprint backlogs

* Strong experience facilitating Agile ceremonies:

o Sprint Planning

jobs.title: Program Manager I, GCOI
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a Program Manager to own catalog defect resolution and readiness execution for Whole Foods Market within the Grocery Catalog Operations and Intel (GCOI) team.  
  
This role is the bridge between the specialists who execute catalog operations and the program and product managers who own the systems behind them. Specialists escalate to you when the SOP runs out. Program and product owners come to you when they need to know what is actually happening in the catalog. You will drive ASIN-level defects to root cause, quantify blast radius, document what you find, and carry recurring failures to the teams that own the fix.  
  
If you like dive-deep problem solving, want to build program management depth in a business where catalog quality is the constraint, and want to be the person holding the real answer, this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Bridge catalog execution and program ownership: Own the escalation path for ASIN-level catalog defects that exceed existing procedures, driving each to root cause or a confirmed accountable owner  
Absorb volume during spikes and coverage gaps rather than only routing it, so the team's SLA position holds when inflow exceeds plan  
Convert operational symptoms into problem statements that program managers, product managers, and engineering partners can act on  
Speak for GCOI in defect triage forums and cross-team working sessions, supplying the operational evidence no partner team can see from their side  
Land partner and product decisions back with the specialist team in executable form: what changed, what the new handling is, what to do differently from the next ticket onward  
Own the documentation trail for every defect you drive (investigation path, root cause, resolution, prevention) and author or refresh SOPs so the next occurrence is resolvable without escalation  
Execute assigned catalog readiness tasks, from ASIN creation through attribute validation, against defined workback schedules  
Mentor L3 Catalog Automation Leads on troubleshooting methodology and catalog tooling, raising what the team resolves without escalation  
  
About the team  
GCOI (Grocery Catalog Operations & Intel) owns catalog operations across Amazon's grocery ecosystem — Wholefoods, Grocery Partnerships, Amazon Fresh, and SSD-G & Quick Commerce. We support catalog maintenance from ASIN/offer creation to attribute maintenance within ASCS. Our differentiator: deep domain knowledge of end-to-end catalog flows lets us design, build, and deploy automation without dedicated engineering headcount, collapsing the cycle from defect identification to automation within the same team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Knowledge of general AI tools

**About Mallow Technologies**

  

Mallow Technologies is a product engineering and development company building digital products for businesses across the globe. We partner with clients to design, build and scale software products end to end.

  

**About the Role**

  

We're looking for Product Owners who thrive in turning problems into working software. While high-level direction may come from product discovery, you'll take it from there defining the right solution for a given problem or need, breaking it down into implementable scope and owning the journey all the way through to a shipped, working product in production. You'll be the bridge between the client's vision, the internal delivery team and the end outcome making sure the right things get built, in the right order, at the right quality and that they land successfully in the hands of users.

  

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys both the problem-solving side figuring out the 'what' and 'how' of a solution and the structure and momentum of seeing it through to a working, live product on a predictable cadence.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the right solution for a given problem, pain point, or business need and translate it into detailed, implementable scope covering user flows, edge cases, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Own and continuously groom the product backlog, prioritizing items in collaboration with clients based on business value, technical dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Gather and analyze client feedback, business requirements, and relevant data/research to support prioritization and solution decisions.
* Drive Agile delivery by actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.

* Track and report project progress against roadmap milestones to both clients and internal stakeholders.
* Own implementation and rollout activities, coordinate UAT cycles, manage go-live activities, and ensure a smooth transition to production.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3-5 years of overall experience, with at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst on client-facing projects.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to understand ambiguous problems or business needs and define appropriate solutions.
* Good judgment and decision-making skills with the ability to evaluate trade-offs between different approaches.
* Ability to refine proposed solutions based on technical feasibility by working closely with Engineering Leads.

* Exposure to multiple domains and diverse project types across our client portfolio.
* A clear growth path toward more senior roles within the Product and Delivery track.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll's Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for **end-to-end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains**. This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.

The Lead Product Owner acts as the **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products**, coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes.

This role is critical to enabling **product-led execution at scale** within the CDO.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Portfolio-Level Product Ownership**

* Own the **overall product vision and execution strategy** across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self-Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:

  + A clear purpose and roadmap
  + Defined success metrics
  + Consistent experience and standards
* Act as the **final decision authority** on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.

**Leadership Coaching**

* Lead, mentor, and coach **Product Owners** to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce **standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication**.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.

**Stakeholder Alignment Business Partnership**

* Serve as an **interface** between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into **sequenced, realistic roadmaps**.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making **transparent, value-based trade-offs**.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in **what will be delivered, when, and why**.

**Roadmap, Backlog Delivery Governance**

* Maintain a **portfolio-level roadmap**, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain **well-defined, ready backlogs** that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:

  + Align sprint and release plans
  + Surface risks and constraints early
  + Manage cross-team dependencies
* Ensure delivery adheres to **CDO governance, readiness, and release standards**.

**Quality, Governance Trust**

* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:

  + Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
  + Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
  + Ensure security and compliance requirements are met
* Ensure products are **operationally ready** and supported post-release.

**Value Realization Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track **adoption, usage, and value metrics** across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver **measurable business impact**, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:

  + Simplify or consolidate products
  + Reduce technical or vendor dependency
  + Improve scalability and user experience
* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.

**Qualifications Experience**

**Required**

* 7+ years of experience in **Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data-centric leadership roles**.
* Proven experience owning **multiple products or domains** in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of **enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms**.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with **senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams**.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.

**Preferred**

* Experience within a **Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization**.
* Familiarity with platforms such as **Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self-service analytics**.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.

**Leadership Behaviors Expectations**

* Thinks and acts **portfolio-first**, not story-by-story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making-and defending-trade-off decisions.
* Focused on **outcomes, adoption, and trust**, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.

**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**

* **Lead Product Owner**: Defines long-term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* **Product Owners**: Own day-to-day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* **Program Managers**: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can **scale product-led execution without chaos**, reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

Business Analyst – Q2C Rapid Delivery (AMER Shift)
  
  
**Description:**  
Salesforce's Quote to Cash (QTC) Innovation team is looking for a Business Analyst, Q2C Rapid Delivery to join our growing organization. This isn't a traditional documentation-and-handoff BA role — we're looking for someone who thinks like an analyst but builds like an engineer: someone who can turn a business problem into a working solution using AI tools, not just a requirements doc.
  
You'll work on enterprise-level projects that scale and streamline internal Quote-to-Cash processes and operations, and you'll collaborate closely with Business SMEs, Product, Architecture, and Engineering Teams. Beyond mapping requirements and handing them off, you'll be expected to prototype, automate, and stand up working tools yourself — using AI-assisted ("vibe coding") tools as your default way of working. We are seeking proactive, self-motivated builders who are comfortable navigating ambiguity, take initiative, and drive project outcomes with minimal oversight.
  
You'll be working closely with our US-based teams, with an approximate shift schedule of 5:00 PM IST to 2:00 AM IST, subject to change based on project needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Develop deep functional expertise across Q2C domain areas (e.g., CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management, or Order Management) over time, building the subject-matter depth needed to anticipate upstream/downstream impacts and guide solution design — not just execute against a defined spec.

The Business Analyst turns business intent into clear, testable requirements for AI and data products, and keeps the backlog, stakeholders, and validation aligned from discovery through UAT.
  
  
**Experience:**
4 to 6 years in business analysis, with at least 2 years on data, analytics, or AI/ML product delivery.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Lead discovery workshops to capture current-state processes, pain points, personas, and use case priorities.
* Write Business and Functional Requirement Documents (BRD/FRD), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Own backlog refinement with the Product Owner; prioritize work by business value and data readiness.
* Map end-to-end workflows, including approval, review, intake, and escalation flows across functions.
* Define business rules, thresholds, scoring logic, severity levels, and KPIs with SMEs.
* Facilitate configuration sessions and translate decisions into build specifications for engineers.
* Maintain traceability from requirements to build, test cases, and deliverables.
* Plan and support UAT: test scenarios, business validation of AI outputs, defect triage, and sign-off.
* Contribute to the RAID log, decision log, status reports, and change-control assessments.
* Produce user playbooks, process documentation, and handover materials.

**Required Skills**

* Strong requirements elicitation, process modeling (BPMN or similar), and gap analysis.
* Agile delivery with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools; comfortable working in two-week sprints.
* Working SQL and data literacy: can read schemas, metadata, and data profiles to validate requirements.
* Ability to define acceptance criteria for AI features, such as accuracy, confidence, and evidence needs.
* Clear written and verbal communication with business, technical, and executive audiences.
* Skilled workshop facilitator who can align multiple stakeholders on one requirement set.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with GenAI, LLM, RAG, or agentic AI products, including human-in-the-loop design.
* Exposure to data governance concepts: metadata, data catalogs, taxonomies, data quality rules, lineage.
* Domain knowledge in pharma or life sciences (commercial, medical, regulatory, launch, or content review).
* Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and dashboard requirement definition.
* Certification such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or CSPO.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.

**Job Summary**

* The Business Analyst, Implementations will work closely with both client IT teams and internal technical teams to acquire, configure, and integrate healthcare data for revenue cycle management projects. This role involves data mapping, building data parsers, and ensuring internal systems are customized to meet client requirements. The ideal candidate will bridge functional and technical needs, ensuring seamless data flow and successful project delivery.

**Essential Functions and Tasks**

* Collaborate with client IT teams to acquire healthcare data feeds (e.g., patient demographics, medical records, case logs, etc.) for revenue cycle management, and gather data/system configuration requirements to pass on to internal IT teams.
* Develop and maintain data mapping specifications, ensuring proper data transformation and structure for integration into internal systems.
* Provide internal IT teams with clear specifications for system configuration, data parsers, and custom workflows to meet client requirements.
* Work with internal teams to ensure data parsers are built, optimized, and tested to maintain data integrity and compatibility with internal systems.
* Coordinate and oversee testing of data integration and system configurations, ensuring all requirements are met and discrepancies resolved.
* Serve as the primary liaison between client IT teams, internal implementation teams, and IT teams, ensuring smooth communication and alignment on project goals.
* Document system configurations, data mappings, and workflows for future reference and alignment between client and internal systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data integration issues in collaboration with internal IT teams, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Identify and implement opportunities to optimize system configurations, data parsers, and integration workflows for efficiency and faster delivery.
* Stay updated on healthcare IT trends and technologies, applying best practices to improve system integrations and process efficiency.

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in business analysis, data integration, or technical roles within the healthcare industry.
* Proven experience with system configuration, data mapping, building data parsers, and working with internal IT teams to customize systems.
* Strong background in healthcare revenue cycle management systems and data integration tools.
* Experience in system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT) for healthcare projects is highly preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of US healthcare revenue cycle management processes, including patient registration, coding, billing, collections, and claims management.
* Experience with system configuration, data mapping, and working with or building data parsers for integration of complex data feeds.
* Proven ability to work closely with client IT teams to gather and translate functional and technical requirements for successful project execution.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify data discrepancies, troubleshoot system issues, and collaborate with internal teams to resolve challenges.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Skilled in creating clear, detailed documentation such as data mappings, system configurations, and technical workflows to support implementation and ongoing operations.
* Ability to stay current with healthcare IT trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data integration and revenue cycle management.
* High attention to detail to ensure data integrity and accurate system configurations that align with client-specific requirements.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities while ensuring timely delivery of project milestones.
* Collaborative team player, able to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including internal IT, operations, and client-facing roles, to drive project success.

jobs.title: Business Analyst_Health Care Domain
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**Role -Business Analyst( Health Care Domain)**

**Total experience- 7years to 10years**

**Location-Hyderabad & Bangalore**

**Experience in Business ANalyst with Healthcare domain in BRD AND FSD**

**If interested send me cv on 6304776536 or bommakanti.sai.vaidehi@pwc.com**

**Preferred candidate profile**

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst who can sit between US healthcare payer and provider business stakeholders and an offshore ETL engineering pod, and turn ambiguous business asks into precise, buildable specifications. The role spans requirement elicitation, source-to-target mapping, business validation logic, UAT ownership, and stakeholder-facing reporting across an enterprise data warehouse an enterprise Operational Data Store, and the downstream extract and BI layers.

This is a hands-on analyst role, not a coordination role. You will profile data yourself in SQL, read ETL job logic, and defend your specifications in front of both the business and the development team.

**Key Responsibilities**

Requirement to specification. Elicit requirements from business and clinical stakeholders and convert them into BRDs, functional specifications, source-to-target mapping (STTM) documents, and testable acceptance criteria that developers can build from without re-interpretation.

Source-to-target mapping and impact analysis. Produce and maintain mapping and business-requirement documentation for data extracts, including impact analysis for schema, entity, and source-system changes.

Business validation (BV) logic. Define the Landing Zone to Persistent Layers reconciliation and business validation rules executed by the ETL BV framework, and investigate count and value mismatches jointly with the development team.

Data analysis and profiling. Write and tune complex SQL to profile source data, validate transformation logic, quantify defect impact, and answer stakeholder data questions independently.

Reporting and visualization. Partner with BI developers on Tableau / Power BI dashboard requirements, wireframes, and metric definitions; validate published outputs against the agreed source of truth.

Release and UAT ownership. Drive UAT planning, test-scenario definition, defect triage, and business sign-off across Dev / QA / UAT / Production cycles, including regulatory submission windows.

Stakeholder management. Run requirement workshops and status reviews with US-based business owners across time zones; surface risks, dependencies, and scope ambiguity early rather than at test time.

Documentation and governance. Maintain runbooks, known-issue articles, data dictionaries, and end-to-end traceability from requirement through to the deployed object.

Required Qualifications

8 10 years of total experience, including a minimum of 4 5 years as a Business Analyst or Data Analyst in the US healthcare domain payer side (claims, enrollment, membership, provider, benefits, capitation, pharmacy) and/or provider side (EMR / clinical data).

Demonstrated ability to convert client requirements into formal business documents BRD / FSD, STTM, use cases, process flows, and requirement traceability matrices.

Strong data warehousing fundamentals — dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, CDC / delta processing, landing–staging–persistent layering, data lineage, reconciliation, and data quality management.

Excellent written and verbal English and the confidence to lead a workshop with senior US stakeholders.
