jobs.title: Business Analyst, Q2C Rapid Delivery
jobs.description:
**Description**
Business Analyst – Q2C Rapid Delivery (AMER Shift)
  
  
****Description:****
Salesforce's Quote to Cash (QTC) Innovation team is looking for a Business Analyst, Q2C Rapid Delivery to join our growing organization. This isn't a traditional documentation-and-handoff BA role — we're looking for someone who thinks like an analyst but builds like an engineer: someone who can turn a business problem into a working solution using AI tools, not just a requirements doc.
  
  
You'll work on enterprise-level projects that scale and streamline internal Quote-to-Cash processes and operations, and you'll collaborate closely with Business SMEs, Product, Architecture, and Engineering Teams. Beyond mapping requirements and handing them off, you'll be expected to prototype, automate, and stand up working tools yourself — using AI-assisted ("vibe coding") tools as your default way of working. We are seeking proactive, self-motivated builders who are comfortable navigating ambiguity, take initiative, and drive project outcomes with minimal oversight.
  
  
You'll be working closely with our US-based teams, with an approximate shift schedule of 5:00 PM IST to 2:00 AM IST, subject to change based on project needs.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****

* Develop deep functional expertise across Q2C domain areas (e.g., CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management, or Order Management) over time, building the subject-matter depth needed to anticipate upstream/downstream impacts and guide solution design — not just execute against a defined spec.
* Partner with Functional Leads and Business SMEs to understand the future-state vision for Quote-to-Cash systems and processes — then go beyond documentation to prototype and build the enhancement yourself using AI-assisted tools.
* Lead requirements discovery with SMEs and stakeholders, and translate findings directly into working artifacts (automations, agents, test scripts, dashboards) rather than static specs alone.
* Map as-is/to-be processes and data flows (Lucidchart or equivalent), replacing manual process diagrams with automated, reusable tooling where possible.
* Build and maintain lightweight automations, workflow tools, and AI agents that solve recurring operational problems.
* Support data migration: mapping, validation, and reconciliation, increasingly via scripted/AI-assisted validation rather than manual checks.
* Use data analysis and BI skills to identify patterns, track KPIs, and build reusable reporting and monitoring.
* Own end-to-end delivery for smaller, well-scoped requests within a fast, iterative cadence — triage, build, validate, and ship.
* Lead and participate in UAT cycles, using automated/AI-driven testing approaches where possible rather than relying solely on manual testing.
* Maintain clear documentation of business rules, configurations, and the automations/agents you build.
* Partner with enablement teams on training and change management for new tools and workflows being rolled out.
* Stay current on emerging AI/automation tooling and actively pilot new approaches for the team.

****Required Skills/Experience****

* 3+ years experience in a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar delivery capacity, ideally in a SaaS or enterprise environment — with demonstrated comfort moving from requirements into hands-on building.
* Background in Quote-to-Cash, CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management, or Order Management systems.
* Direct experience using AI-assisted development/automation tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) to build working solutions, scripts, or agents — not just conceptual familiarity.
* Familiarity with Lucidchart, Smartsheets, or similar tools for process/project documentation.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving delivery environment.
* Excellent communication skills — able to work with both business and technical stakeholders and explain what an AI-built solution does and why.
* Curious, proactive, builder mindset — someone who prefers shipping a working prototype over writing a longer spec.
* Hands-on experience with data migration, validation, or system integration projects.
* Proven aptitude for data analysis/reporting — SQL/SOQL, and Tableau/PowerBI or similar BI tools.

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce administration, automation platforms (flows, AI agents, process builders), or workflow/bot building tools.
* Experience building or maintaining automated UAT/testing frameworks.
* Exposure to large-scale transformation, data-heavy, or M&A integration initiatives.
* Experience supporting New Product Introduction or Business Operations teams.

jobs.description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

**Vision & Strategy**

* Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
* Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
* Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

* Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, automation, testing, and DevOps best practices.
Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the platform organization.  

  

Your future at Kyndryl

Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good

What you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Experience

Experience supporting enterprise-scale cloud and data platforms.  

  

Preffered Experience

  
Strong communication & soft skills.  



**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**Job Description**

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Sr Business Analyst - Product Owner**

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop innovative software solutions that enable our customers to advance science and improve human health. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional environment where Product Management, Software Engineering, Software Verification & Validation, Quality, and other functions work together to deliver high-quality products. The software team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the definition, design, development, verification, validation, and delivery of world-class software products for clinical and research settings.

This individual will translate product and customer needs into clear, complete, testable, and implementation-ready requirements and user stories so that Development and V&V teams have a common understanding of intended product behavior. The Product Owner will act as the single point of contact for functional understanding of the product and will own the quality and completeness of requirements throughout the software development lifecycle.

You are comfortable working with technical and business stakeholders, facilitating decisions, identifying gaps, and constructively challenging assumptions. Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, KarnātakaSenior Associate, Business Analysis

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and relational databases—cutting-edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward to today, and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one, impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry, and each other.

As a Senior Associate at Capital One, you will apply your analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact how the company manages customer friction and resolution. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

**Team Description**

Welcome to Customer Navigator. We are the central nervous system for enterprise-wide customer resolution, serving as the one-stop engine to resolve complaints across all Capital One Lines of Business (LOBs).

We are not just improving processes; we are completely re-engineering how we understand and resolve customer friction. Our platform aggregates massive amounts of fragmented enterprise data, mapping it into a seamless, chronological "journey format" for our agents. By layering advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning over this data within an easily understandable User Interface (UI), we empower our teams to resolve complex customer issues with unprecedented speed, empathy, and accuracy.

**Role Description**

General responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* **Bridge Business and Data:** Partner with cross-functional teams (Tech, Lines of Business, Product) to translate complex data requirements into actionable product features for the Customer Navigator platform.
* **Analytical Problem Solving:** Support the business strategy by analyzing data to identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI for predicting, understanding, and resolving complaints before they escalate.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Act as a liaison between business users and the product team; gather feedback, understand processes, uncover opportunities to improve decision-making, and drive continuous improvement in workflows.
* **Data Translation:** Interpret and translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that inform complaint resolution strategies.
* **Communication:** Communicate technical concepts and research results effectively to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and non-specialist colleagues, through structured presentations and storytelling.
* **Execution Focus:** Display an intense focus on achieving both short- and long-term goals, helping drive business intent and product adoption in an uncertain and fluid environment.

**The ideal candidate is:**

* **Inquisitive:** You thrive on solving big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* **Technical:** You’re comfortable navigating complex analytical solutions and have hands-on experience conducting business analyses using modern data tools.
* **Innovative:** You continually are on the lookout for novel approaches, solutions, and emerging technologies (like GenAI) to solve business problems and improve the customer experience.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics, Econometrics, Finance or Operations Research).
* At least 2 years of professional work experience in analytics, business analysis or data-driven product management.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience with Python, R, SQL and relational databases.
* Experience in the financial services industry, specifically dealing with cross-LOB operations, customer experience or complaint resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy, and proficiency in key econometric and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, regression modeling, etc.).
* Experience translating ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions and tangible product features.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: Salesforce BA - QA
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented
**Business Analyst**
with 3 years of experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for gathering and analyzing business requirements, modeling processes, and proposing data-driven solutions to improve operations and system efficiency. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, a collaborative mindset, and effective communication skills to translate business needs into functional requirements and technical outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Requirements Gathering and Analysis**

* Serve as a primary liaison between business users, product owners, technical teams, and QA.
* Build strong relationships across departments to foster trust, transparency, and collaboration.
* Facilitate regular requirements, sprint grooming, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Proactively manage Product Owner expectations, communicate risks, and ensure alignment on scope and deliverables.
* Translate stakeholder feedback into actionable requirements and ensure follow-through.
* Elicit and define requirements that align with both functional specifications and business objectives.
* Draft Feature documentation and User Stories, and plan to obtain necessary approvals from stakeholders.
* Define sprint scope and collaborate with the team to plan sprint goals and overall delivery timelines for the project.

**Process Analysis and Improvement**

* Gain end-to-end understanding of the application to derive requirements aligned with platform capabilities.
* Document current and future state business processes using flowcharts.
* Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and bottlenecks; propose data-driven improvements.
* Monitor process improvements post-implementation to measure their effectiveness and adjust as needed.

**Stakeholder Management and Communication**

* Act as a liaison between Product Owner, technical teams, QA, and project management.
* Manage cross-functional team relationships, negotiate where necessary, and ensure alignment between business needs and technical feasibility.
* Communicate findings, updates, and solutions through clear and concise documentation, reports, and presentations.
* Maintain transparency through regular feedback loops, fostering trust and long-term collaboration.

**Implementation and Testing**

* Collaborate with the Design and Development teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.
* Monitor daily progress against defined targets to ensure alignment with overall project goals.
* Collaborate with QA teams to define test scenarios, test cases, and UAT plans.
* Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet business requirements.
* Provide post-implementation support, including resolving issues, training users, and stabilizing solutions.
* Develop comprehensive user manuals and training materials to ensure smooth adoption.
* Lead or assist in changing management efforts to ensure user readiness and organizational alignment.

**Functional Specification and Documentation**

* Create detailed functional specifications outlining system functionality, data flows, user roles, and expected outcomes.
* Act as a point of reference throughout the development cycle, minimizing scope creep and miscommunication.
* Ensure specifications are technically sound, aligned with business expectations, and usable by developers and QA.

**Training and Support**

* Assess training needs and deliver end-user training sessions via workshops, demos, and manuals.
* Ensure users are equipped to utilize new systems effectively and confidently.
* Provide continuous support for post-implementation, addressing any issues, questions, or enhancement requests.
* Promote higher user adoption and productivity through effective onboarding and guidance.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor implemented solutions for performance, user feedback, and alignment with business goals.
* Encourage a culture of ongoing optimization, proposing enhancements based on system usage data and evolving needs.
* Facilitate review sessions through retrospectives to discuss gaps, gather feedback, and drive iterative improvements.
* Identify and highlight risks to deliverables in a timely manner and escalate them to the Product Owner for resolution and guidance.

**Technical Skills**

* Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role.
* Experience in Salesforce CRM, ERP, or enterprise applications is an Advantage.
* Proficient in business process modeling (Visio, Lucidchart), documentation, and collaboration tools (Azure DevOps, Microsoft Office).
* Working knowledge of data analysis tools (Excel, SQL) and UAT/test planning.
* Professional certifications (CBAP) is a plus.

**Non-Technical Skills**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
